description: This file defines a CKEditor 5 plugin for handling linked Drupal media elements, including conversion between view and model, and support for manual decorators.

classes.name: DrupalLinkMediaEditing
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 plugin class that manages model-view conversions and manual decorators for linked Drupal media elements.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, extends schema, adds conversions, and enables manual decorators.

methods.name: _enableManualDecorators
methods.description: Sets up conversion handlers for manual link decorators on Drupal media elements.
